description: Returns whether the app's pre sells through Stripe's test mode, and `testMode`: "separate" (the developer needs a test account of their own, opened at onboardingUrl with Stripe's test data), "same" (this server is in test mode and the payout account serves) or "off" (no test mode here, so pre test purchases fail), and `account`, the state of that account. Changes nothing; neblla_pre_stripe_test sets it.
name: neblla_pre_stripe_test_read
title: Pre stripe test read
